body:
The FOMC meets July 28–29, 2026, with the policy decision on Wednesday, July 29. The remaining 2026 meetings are September 15–16, October 27–28, and December 8–9, per the Federal Reserve’s FOMC calendar. Each date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it, and the Committee may also meet unscheduled.

What time is the Fed rate decision announced? [...] ## When is the July 2026 FOMC meeting?

The July 2026 meeting is a two-day meeting held Tuesday, July 28 and Wednesday, July 29, with the policy decision on the 29th. This appears on the Federal Reserve’s own FOMC calendar, which the Board last updated on July 8, 2026. [...] # FOMC Meeting July 28–29: What to Know About Fed Decision Day

The Federal Open Market Committee meets on July 28–29, 2026. The policy statement is released at 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday, July 29, followed by the Chair’s press conference at 2:30 p.m. ET. This is one of the four 2026 meetings that does not include a Summary of Economic Projections, so there is no dot plot. This is factual reporting, not investment advice or a forecast of any rate decision.

The next FOMC meeting isJuly 28–29, 2026. The Federal Reserve is scheduled to announce its interest rate decision on Wednesday, July 29, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET, which is 13 days from today. The Federal Open Market Committee holds eight regularly scheduled meetings per year.

## ❓FOMC Meeting FAQs - Your Questions Answered

### When is the next FOMC meeting?

The next FOMC meeting is July 28–29, 2026. The Federal Reserve is scheduled to announce its interest rate decision on Wednesday, July 29, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET.

### What is the Fed meeting schedule for 2026? [...] Heading into theJuly 28–29, 2026 meeting, the confirmed starting point is the current target range of 3.5% – 3.75%. At the June 2026 meeting, the FOMC held that range and said inflation remained elevated relative to its 2% goal. The Committee also said future action depends on incoming information. That official record does not guarantee a hold, hike, or cut at the next meeting.

### What is known before the announcement

A joint meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee and the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System was held in the offices of the Board of Governors on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. and continued on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m.1 indicated that this decline after the June FOMC meeting was attributable in part to investors' perceptions of the Committee's strong resolve to deliver price stability, as reflected in the June FOMC statement and press conference.
